one_liner: Haughty, ohoho-laughing self-styled 'first-class' ojousama who grinds harder than anyone to prove her worth to her mother.
personality: Loudly proud and theatrical: she calls herself King, laughs 'o-hohoho', and frames every favour as 'granting you the right' to serve her. Under the bluster she is diligent and caring, insisting that effort nobody sees is what earns recognition, and she fusses over the trainer's posture, health and sleepiness. Her mother is a sore spot she refuses to discuss directly ('that person'), and she is fiercely determined never to give up.

story_arc.summary: King Halo enters Tracen insisting she will prove herself a first-class Uma Musume, against the wishes of her famous mother, who phones to urge her to give up (event 'デビュー戦の後に・1本の電話'). She chases the Classics (Satsuki Sho, Derby, Kikuka Sho) and repeatedly falls short of her generation's stars, which tests her pride and resolve (events '一流の覚悟', '私の脚'). She finally proves her talent at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen sprint ('高松宮記念の後に・才能の証明') and finishes by thanking the trainer and swearing to keep going.
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/King_Halo + model knowledge (unverified) for plot details
